expectations.text: Uses Dialog or Modal from @codecademy/gamut rather than a hand-rolled overlay
expectations.evidence: import { Dialog } from '@codecademy/gamut'; wraps Dialog with variant, confirmCta, cancelCta.

expectations.text: Does not manually implement Escape-key or outside-click dismiss logic
expectations.evidence: No addEventListener/keydown/click handlers anywhere; relies entirely on Dialog's onRequestClose.

expectations.text: Does not use a hand-rolled position:fixed/absolute overlay shell
expectations.evidence: No styled overlay markup at all -- Dialog is used directly.

expectations.text: Confirm/Cancel wired through the component's real props
expectations.evidence: confirmCta={{ children: 'Delete', onClick: onConfirm }}, cancelCta={{ children: 'Cancel' }}.
